title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：transport　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 transport 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the driver ① provided the transport that no passenger in the station would have noted, and he said the providing was the whole of the day. The ② transport, meaning the carriage itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; transport, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of transport in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ transport at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Transport, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the driver said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the transport was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the carriage. The ⑥ transport, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; transport, he said, is either something you provide or the only word that means both carriage and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ transport had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ transport of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of noting; transport, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ transport I remember is the transport noted in the timetable, which closed in 1992 and is still noted as the quietest in the station. ⑩ Transport, my mother said in 1994, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all transport, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like carriage. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 交通；运输（指车站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 交通；运输（指那种交通本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：provide the transport 提供这一种交通
D. n. 交通；运输（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 交通之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的交通之事）
F. n. 交通；运输（指时刻表里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 交通、往来（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 往来（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: provided the transport that no passenger in the station would have noted
The transport, meaning the carriage itself and not the ticket
Every sort of transport in that station
the transport at the far platform
the transport was the whole of the matter
the transport had become a line in a timetable
The transport of the whole thing

answers.why: provide the transport 意为“提供这一种交通”，1985 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯记下的一种交通做了一遍。
transport 意为“交通；运输”，指那种交通本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
transport 意为“交通；运输”，指车站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
transport 意为“交通；运输”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
transport 意为“交通、往来”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种往来就是那件事的全部。
transport 意为“往来”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种交通，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
transport 意为“交通；运输”，指时刻表里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1990 年这一种成了时刻表里的一行。
transport 意为“交通之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的交通之事是一处车站和三个日子的记下。
transport 意为“交通；运输”，我记得的是时刻表里记下过的那一种，1992 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一种。
transport 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，交通是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的交通。
